notes.title: Major update ! 12/2023
notes.content:
Greetings fellow dollcitizens,

We're back after a long period of absence, during which we faced challenges that temporarily halted our project. Rest assured, it was never abandoned; we managed to rescue it from hiatus and are ready to dive back in. We sincerely appreciate your incredible patience and apologize wholeheartedly for the extended wait.

We're excited to announce a long-awaited update, featuring the release of the original soundtrack later this month and a playable demo coming your way in the next few days. For the current update, we've modernized the gaming system to align with the latest VR locomotion standards. We've introduced a more intuitive selection process, a new simpler and less restrictive tutorial (in beta), bug fixes, and significant overall optimization.

The new gameplay now includes lateral movements, and it will no longer be possible to move while controlling a bot, eliminating potential conflicts. Additionally, we've added a cinema room to enhance your experience.

Beyond these improvements, minor updates are in the pipeline to fine-tune certain aspects of the game. We want to assure you that the next major update won't keep you waiting for a year. Thank you for your ongoing support and understanding.

Best regards,
[Development Team]

notes.title: Major update on the way!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow dollcitizens!


We're finally back on tracks with a major update coming soon!
First, thanks for all your comments and constructive feedback. We've been scratching our heads to find the best way to bring Acidpunk: Echoes of Doll City to today's VR standards.

We have decided to remove some features in the control scheme to bring back a more straightforward and intuitive gameplay. This will also significantly improve performance for everyone. This will make it easier and quicker to integrate the remaining levels of the main story.
New immersive roomscale areas are being finalized. A new, shorter and simpler tutorial is also in the making. For those of you who followed the game since the beginning and missed the good old side scroller levels, you will be very pleased, as several ones will be integrated to the main game to take you further towards the end of this journey! 

To sum up: better and simpler controls, more intuitive gameplay and more levels. 

Stay tuned.

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: 06/24/2021 Major update
notes.content:
New skin for an old ceremony!

Doll City: Prologue changes its name to become ACIDPUNK: Echoes of Doll City!

Why did we take this decision?

First of all because we think it sounds great and secondly because we find that it fits much better with the atmosphere of the game. More importantly, the subtitle "Prologue" might have been misleading and would let players think they would only get the first part of a game series. ACIDPUNK is a complete game, and you will be able to live your adventure from beginning to end, no strings attached.

Here is a summary of what we've been working on for this update:
- Gameplay and controls optimization
- Faster loading times
- Increased overall stability
- Many bug fixes
- Graphics overhaul

[previewyoutube=R3NTWHAKBMo;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you will enjoy the work we have done so far. We will now focus on the next level of ACIDPUNK to bring you the conclusion of your fantastic journey to the twisted Doll City megalopolis.

Do not hesitate to give us your feedback and general thoughts about the game, thanks a lot for this!

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Focus on next update: #4 Soundtrack
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Dollcitizens!

From dark alleys to impressive landscapes, you will never walk alone in Doll City. Indeed, wherever you go, music will be omnipresent.

From ambient soundscapes to vibrant synthwave, the soundtrack also includes a large variety of genres: nostalgic ballads, psychedelic rock, dark vaporwave, haunting classical themes with hints of chiptune and metal... Your ears are in for a treat.

Each music has its own atmosphere and purpose, and has been created to fit perfectly with the scenery. Some hints about the main story can be hidden in vocoded lyrics, two themes might be playing at once and fit together like pieces of a puzzle, and parts of some levels can be lived like interactive music videos.

[previewyoutube=YRKPxON_oQw;full][/previewyoutube]

More than 30 tracks have been written to tell you everything about the madness and loneliness of the lost souls of Doll City. As we are getting closer to the final release, more sounds will be unveiled. 

We also plan to release the soundtrack later this year, both in Steam and digital music platforms, tell us in the comments if you are interested!

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: March 2021 Major update.
notes.content:
Hello fellow dollcitizens!

After lots of work, we are back with a major update and we will be posting hotfixes during all week to correct a few details and problems you may encounter. The pandemix is slowing us down in our beta testing process but we are making good progress. 
Let's skip to the important part: what's new with this update?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/a63ee8d4b3bc5a9f755f03fa16217171babd75c3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/2c81de845f6c580cbbf4f6e7de9a79eaa80f65c4.png[/img][/url]

Global features

Totally rewrote main character gameplay and controls.
Availbale perks and enhancements are displayed on your right arm.
AR button turns blue when activated. You also need to press it a little longer to activate in order to prevent missclicks - wait for the beep!
New combat mode including a brand new shield (remember to hold your shield in front of you to move straight).
New double jump animation when controlling a bot.
Changed checkpoints and teleporters 3D models.
Dispatched new bots patrols and and turrets (sound design in progress).
Enhanced bots IA and reactivity.
New level.
Changed the path in older levels.
Skip the introduction and quicker access to the main game.
New achievements, more are on their way.
Invisible walls got more visible^^
Fixed a bug when access cards made controllers appear.
Fixed potential conflicts between different HMDs and controllers.
Fade to black during transitions.
Added slight controller rumble when grabbing a ladder.
New musical themes added.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/ac42ce58f70ec0aedfed6afb1654dbf0374ba35b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/259b6d69a892cc392e5db0fc0ce444a6d7b45350.png[/img][/url]




Tutorial entirely redone

Tutorial automatically starts when you lauch the game for the first time. Still accessible from the HUD.
Added explanation videos for some actions.
Redesign of the main path.
Added a bot hacking section.
Added a combat section.
You can now leave the tutorial at anytime to go back to the main HUD.

Level select mode :
New visuals
Auto detects player's HMD & controllers (Oculus/HTC/Index/Touch/Wand/Knuckles).
Seated / gamepad mode is not available for now and will make its comeback for the final release.

HUD

Fixed a bug when level selection didn't work correctly.
New museum level (we will add way more content alongside new updates).

New movie theater level (new shows will start with the next update).
New level (level 7).

Level 1 (minor changes)

Fixed some block volume problems when moving with stick/trackpad.
Minor visual improvements.

Level 2  (minor changes)

Fixed a bug when music wouldn't start correctly during the second half of the level.
Added interactive bubbles to display comic book pages.
Added patrolling bots.
New path to prevent annoying backtracking.
Minor visual improvements.

Level 3  (minor changes)

Added gameplay sequences during the roller coaster part.
Fixed player position on HTC HMDs during the roller coaster.
Giant fingers can now touch you. Fingers are meant to TOUCH, aren't they?

Level 4  (minor changes)

Added videos for the second part of the level.

Level 5  (minor changes)

Minor visual improvements.
Fixed a bug when the door would stay closed.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/d2bcde3edef3292d13c97bbb433b84a1169adca0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/5c616eaa2afdb0634dbe84c131cc3c650a7ea4fc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/2ba4fc8aece89872cd9ee8e236cdff3c43d78283.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/e0e4d82320247d149e9ec0156e80894a8da52903.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Hello fellow Dollcitizens,[/b]

  First, a huge thanks for the detailed feedback after our last update, it has been a great help. Here is a minor update resolving some issues you may have encountered.

Data03: 

	- Fixed teleport issues.

Data04:

	- The « rollercoaster » cinematic didn’t start properly. It’s working now.

Data06: 

	- Fixed teleport not activating near AR Chip #2.

Data10

	- Trackpad locomotion now works after opening the last door.
	- Fixed a display bug where you couldn’t see properly through the window in the end of the level.
	- Some assets & LOD issues were corrected (textures still displayed as lo-res even when the player is getting close).

We are still working on some issues but we need a bit more time:

	- Data04 level optimization for people with more modest PCs.
	- Acoustic & visual redesign of the turrets in order to fit better with rest of the universe.
	- Further gameplay improvements and optimizations (rotation, teleport…).
	- Correct controllers display position for Valve Index users.
	- Finalizing advanced tutorial.

For the final release:

	- Better and more intuitive use of AR Vision to display hidden messages & intel.
	- More advanced remote control of other bots using your integrated hacking device.
	- More AR Chips, complete story integration and new gameplay mechanics.
	- Integration of the Bonus Room.
	- Integration of the Museum.
	- New levels to guide you to the end of the story. 
	- Finalizing gamepad/seated mode (for old school gamers / people who discovered the game during the DK2 era).
	- Cyber drugs which will affect your vision. And your health… Winners can use drugs, but the right ones in a responsible way^^
	- More SFX & music, overall sound mixing & optimization.
	- Soundtrack & art book release.

Here are our ambitions with this project. We want you to have a psychedelic trip in an original cyberpunk universe, unlike anything you have seen or heard. You will have all the keys to understand the plot and uncover the mysteries of Doll City, and make this story yours.

Doll City isn’t and won’t be a FPS, even if you can encounter a few opponents on your way, they are not here to artificially raise the difficulty of the game. Many other things can kill you in this dreaded megalopolis…

Like in any exploration / adventure game, you will have to unblock paths, solve puzzles and finally discover what R’aid is looking for inside Project M’s data maze. 

We want to offer you something enjoyable, beautiful and most importantly bring you a different experience than anything you experienced in VR so far. 

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Summer major update is finally here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow Dollcitizens![/b]

It took us a fair amount of time, but the wait is finally over! Doll City’s major update is here, after months of hard work. Eight new room scale levels have been included, giving you a better picture of what the final version will be like. Seated / gamepad version will be unveiled for the final release of the game.

The worldwide sanitary situation has affected our work more than expected, as we couldn’t use large exhibitions anymore to make a great number of people beta test our new features. Working from home isn’t always easy, too^^. 

Every level haven’t been optimized yet, which will be done for the final release. Older levels will also be upgraded on a regular basis, with more frequent updates as we are getting closer to the final version of the game (which should happen between late 2020 / early 2021).

[u]Here is what’s new: [/u]

	- Valve index controllers are now supported.
	- A useful hook for grabbing from a distance (you might have gone older and developed some form of arthritis since the first release of the game: we do care about our older supporters).
	- 8 new levels so you can play the real beginning of the story.
	- New SFX, musics and ambiances.
	- New gameplay elements and optimizations.
	- Scenario is progressively implemented, giving you a fair hint of what’s really going on in Doll City.
	- New highly immersive roller coasters synchronized to sweet musical themes.
	- Simple puzzles are gradually making their appearance.
	- New basic foes, to make sure you make good use of your brand new blaster gun.
	- Bugs corrections and a few surprises along the path…

[u]TODO:[/u]

	- Further pimping of older levels and zones.
	- New main story and backstory elements.
	- Huge ingame sound mix and rebalance and new SFX and musical themes.
	- More surprises and levels…

Thanks again for your patience and support, do not hesitate to give us feedback on your experience so far, and if you find any bug we missed, please do tell us, we will correct those asap as we plan to make more regular upgrades until the final version.

Have a blast,

Team InfiniVerse.

notes.title: Huge update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello fellow dollcitizens!

While more than half the planet is on quarantine, life goes on in Doll City!

First, we hope that you and your loved ones are okay. It's a hard time for everyone and being stuck home can be difficult for many of us. We try to take advantage of the situation and work double shift to bring you a great cyberpunk (some would say acidpunk^^) VR experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/e1e55edaa24dec7b6d40433a604c77a6b578fe6c.png[/img]

Like we said in the previous post, many things changed in Doll City: Prologue and a huge update is on its way:

- improved gameplay mechanics
- tons of new interactions
- new user-friendly tutorial
- new levels
- optimized, more beautiful and way bigger existing levels for a brand new experience
- new musics and full sound design integration for the first levels
- story mode progression
- breathtaking sceneries and ambiances
- visit the unfamous Raven Hotel and free roam through huge parts of the city
- finally meet the dreaded M0TH3R
- secrets waiting to be unveiled
- and many more wonders!

The wait is well worth it, be sure of this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25860350/12e5e7ffd645d78c292ef89216df4b5cd06ad525.png[/img]

To thank you for your patience, we also posted 3 EPs on Soundcloud. This is only a fragment of the vibrant soundtrack made by Aerosteak, covering different musical styles. Final OST will be more than 30 tracks long (excluding the most dronish and ambient tracks which will also be included as a bonus) for a hefty 2h30 length so far! You may have already heard some of these tunes ingame, but there are some songs you never heard before. Listening to them ingame alongside breathtaking new visuals will be a mindblowing experience, trust us!

https://soundcloud.com/aerosteak/sets/dc-ep1

https://soundcloud.com/aerosteak/sets/dc-ep2

https://soundcloud.com/aerosteak/sets/dc-ep3

Drop him a word or a kind message if you like it, like every musician he is eager for compliments^^


If you want to see or hear more about Doll City: Prologue on a regular basis, be sure to check our Twitter as we update it quite often: https://twitter.com/InfiniVerseVR


Stay safe, fellow dollcitizens, the streets and back alleys of Doll City are waiting for your return!

notes.title: Fall 2019 update now available!
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow Dollcitizens![/b]

It's been a long long time since our last update, but it's worth the wait.
As we are getting closer to the final release, we've put a lot of efforts redesigning whole game mechanics and adding new levels, sounds and music. The gameplay is now slicker and more intuitive. Here is a list of what's new:

[u]Ingame menu:[/u]
	- More locomotion modes available
	- Comfort mode 30° rotation / smooth trackpad rotation
	- Revamped interface and sound design
	- Various bug fixes / selection now works properly

[u]Roomscale character gameplay mechanics:[/u]
	- Teleport / dash mode rewritten from the ground up
	- Introduction of AR Chips to interact with
	- New AR mode button to display AR Chips informations and upgrades
	- New Player and UI sound design

[u]New tutorial level:[/u]
	- Get familiar with every Doll City gameplay mechanics
	- Learn basic and advanced gameplay in a neutral zone

[u]New HUD / Main menu level:[/u]
	- A brand new level selection interface
	- A few surprises, feel free to explore

[u]Save game system updated:[/u]
	- Your progression is now properly saved

[u]New levels and experiences:[/u]
	- Explore a derelict sewers system

notes.title: Dollcitizens news
notes.content:
Hello fellow Dollcitizens!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25860350/2ba4fc8aece89872cd9ee8e236cdff3c43d78283.jpg[/img]

Latest news from the InfiniVerse team about Doll City's progress. As you may know, we are a very small team: 2 developpers, a musician / sound designer and a story teller / translator.  We want to bring you a quality experience, an amazing journey in a psychedelic cyberpunk universe. Devil being in the details, we are working hard to make this this game as complete and unique as possible. Enough talk for now, let's get to the point: where is Doll City Prologue heading to?

For the time being, you can play the first 10 levels either in roomscale or seated mode. Each mode brings a totally different gameplay and visual experience. We strongly encourage you to play them both, they will show you two sides to Doll City's story.

Main differences

Roomscale mode (Vive controllers / Oculus Touch)

- locomotion systems: dash or trackpad (trackpad mode can be switched between tactile/sliding or pressing on HTC Vive)
- synergy gameplay: you can control another character from a distance on some levels
- multitask robotic hands avatar (flashlight / gun / toolkit...)
- unique interactions

Seated mode (xbox compatible gamepad)

- left stick locomotion, you can switch to dash or teleport if you are prone to motion sickness
- you can make our virtual body appear / disappear according to your preferences and comfort
- aiming with your head
- 3rd person control on some levels (sidescroller mode, teleport still possible)
-eclairage frontale

For both modes

- ingame menu with video options (a Geforce 970 is recommended for minimum settings, a 1070 brings you a superior graphic quality)
- go back easily to the main menu
- during early access, the first 10 levels are unlocked from the start. However, we strongly recommend to play them by chronological order to fully assimilate gameplay mechanics 

What's expected for 2018?

- lots of new sound FX, better ingame mixing and spatialization to bring a deeper immersion
- complete storytelling and definitive english translation
- new comic book pages
- 10 new levels full of surprises, both in roomscale and seated mode
- every known bug and glitch should be corrected after early access
- Steam achievements and trading cards
- Windows MR compatibility
- complete soundtrack available (around 20 original tunes) 
- a VR soundtrack (a totally new and radical experience, scheduled for shortly after the final game's main release). We'll give you more details in a little while!
- a complete story: you will finally know the truth about Doll City's darkest secrets!
- a bonus mode with many surprises, presented as a free roaming sector of the city with many places to visit (movie theater, museum, information booths and hidden secrets...)

Thank you all for your support, cheering comments and constructive criticism and see you very soon for a new major update!

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Major update 2 - Oculus Touch support and more
notes.content:
Hello, fellow doll citizens!

We want to thank you for all your feedbacks. We haven't included all of your suggestions yet, but many have been taken in account with this update, and the other ones should be included in the next minor updates (see list at the end).

For this major update, we have included:

- The Oculus Touch support in roomscale is of course the big addition brought by this update. We know that you are a lot to have been waiting for it since a long time, and we want to thank you for your patience. We hope that you will have a lot of fun discovering Doll City in roomscale mode.


- New introductions in levels 1 and 3

- Correction of the roomscale menu on the return button on the graphics pannel

- Correction of the ingame menu for the trackpad locomotion speed

- Added: a switch to quickly choose between teleportation and trackpad
locomotion without the need to enter the menu to keep the game immersion. Teleportation is considered as one of the character's abilities, and sometimes you will have to switch to this locomotion mode to keep going.

(note: right now, the trackpad mode encounters conflicts in a few levels, and so it has been deactivated in those levels for the moment.)

- Minor bugs and some elements of the scenery have been fixed

- Correction of the fall during level 7 in roomscale mode


The next updates should include: (the elements are not sorted in any particular order)

- Correction of the selection problems in the in game menu
- Reactivation of the saving system
- Addition of new drugs
- Play/stop interactions with the music radios
- Sounds on every items with which the character can interact
- Trackpad locomotion fixed on every level
- We will progressively add the remaining levels 
- Block volumes on every item
- Health regeneration system
- Integration of the scenario
- Deployment of the final sound design on every level
- Return of the defense turrets

Best, 
Infiniverse team

notes.title: New major update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow doll citizens!

Here is the first major update including new gameplay and levels both for gamepad and roomscale modes.

For now roomscale mode is only available for HTC Vive. But don't worry, Oculus Rift support should be relased soon, we're working on it. 

What's new:

- 10 levels for gamepad mode, for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift
- 10 levels for Roomscale mode, for HTC Vive
- New gameplay for gamepad mode, with first person view and sidescroller third person view
- Several choices of locomotion: teleportation/dash/trackpad
- Items to pick up (access cards, boxes, hallucinogenic substances...) 
- Advanced interactions with the environnment
- A unique trip, in a universe where blurring the lines between reality, mind trips and virtuality
- New design for the comic book events
- New sounds and music (a lot remains to be included yet)
- New ingame menu
- A way to switch graphics quality/supersampling 

Though this isn't the final version, it allows the players to have a good preview of where Doll City is heading to: a game mixing exploration and immersion, with various gameplay phases. 

The game immerses you in the story of a derelict megalopolis told through full-scale comic-book pages, with a soundtrack paying tribute to early 80s electronic music.

Welcome to this new update of Doll City, a one of a kind cyberpunk trip.


Team Infiniverse

notes.title: Doll City : news
notes.content:
Hello fellow Doll-Citizens!


First, we would like to apologize for the long silence, we missed you too! But no worries, we are still hard working on Doll City's development!

Many things happened during summer, one of the programmers left the team to work full-time on his own projects, leaving us with a lot of stuff to re-organize. The original team is now back on tracks, and we had to clean the project of every unfinished piece of code and come back to our original idea of what the game should be. Although it was very time-consuming, we are very happy with the results so far and it's a pleasure to find a better work atmosphere!

Before making this announcement, we wanted to make sure we could keep on our promises and deliver a good game, so here is what you should expect:

	- A better, tighter and more intuitive gameplay
	- More interactions with the environment
	- More levels and music
	- Better translations and user interface

This next update including the first 10 levels for both modes (seated 3rd person mode, and roomscale 1st person mode) to give you a better overview of what the game will be.

See you very soon!


Team InfiniVerse A.K.A. Doll City's OGs

notes.title: Doll City Beta is now available!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Doll-Citizens!


First thank you all for your patience! The long awaited beta is finally here, and you can access it using the beta branch of the game (properties --> BETA --> dollcitybeta). Of course, the game still being in beta, there will be probably some bugs left. We will spend the next days correcting every error that we can find. We will be checking the discussion boards daily so feel free to give us your feedback and comments!

Being a very small team (at first we were two developpers, a sound designer and a scriptwriter), we originally planned Doll City as a smaller VR side scroller project. But when we laid our greasy little hands on the HTC Vive and discovered roomscale, it blew our minds! This is why we kept improving the game mechanics and had to re-imagine everything to meet our expectations of what a VR game should be. We hired a third developper to help us and took the hard decision to delay the release of Doll City by a few month in order to offer you a complete and satisfying VR experience. 

We added a more complex gameplay, including infiltration and shooting. We also decided to create a much bigger environment, with some entire neighbourhoods ready for exploration. We also had to rewrite the main storyline to remain coherent with the game's universe and the new levels. More polished sounds and music have also been added (a lot are still waiting to be integrated though) and we began working on the overall mix.

Today you are going to get your first taste of these new features, and we hope you'll like it! The final version is getting closer evryday, and we can't wait for you to discover the whole story and many surprises of Doll City.

Again we want to thank you all for making videos or sharing your feedbacks with us. This really helped us improve the game.


Important information about this update:

- Doll City gets a new, more complex gameplay: infiltration.
- Right now, roomscale mode is only available for the HTC Vive. But we are working hard on bringing it to Oculus Touch as soon as possible.
- Seated mode can be played with HTC Vive, Oculus Rift or OSVR, with an old fashioned early 21st century gamepad. 
- The options menu is not available yet. It will be available in a short time.


What's next:

- New levels, which will lead you to the conclusion of the main story and uncover some dark secrets...
- New gameplay elements will make their appearance in the final version.
- To thank you for your patience, a free bonus mode will appear shortly after the final release. It will have a part of the city in free roaming mode, with new things to discover: minigames, musics, videos...

Cheers!

The InfiniVerse team

notes.title: Ch-ch-ch-ch-changes! Big update coming in a few days!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that the first big update to Doll City is finally coming the 23rd of April! It took us a while, but we made lots of changes to the gameplay system, lots of new sfx and music as well as many other things which you will discover by yourselves...

First, roomscale gameplay will only be available for HTC Vive. A roomscale Oculus version is in the works, and will follow shortly. However, it will still be possible to play the game in seated mode (both Vive & Oculus).

For all of you who followed us or invested in the early access, we want you to know that we worked like crazies to make Doll City what it is now and want to thank you for your patience and useful comments! It took more time than we thought, but we are very proud of the result. You will be able to make your own opinion in a few days, and we can't wait for your reactions!

Of course, we will provide more information  and details when the update releases on 04/23/17.

Cheers

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Diary # 6
notes.content:
Hi Doll-citizens!
We have done all the cinematic for the next update.
Doll City: Prologue has three different types of cinematics:
- On a screen. Classic video cinematic, but on a big screen implemented in a game environment.
- Ingame. A short tutorial cinematic implemented into the level structure.
- Cinematic level. An entirely scripted level part, which allows us to make a big real-time cinematic.

notes.title: Breaking news 3 RGBradio 69.42 Doll-City
notes.content:
Dear Doll-Citizens, here we are, this is the end of the year 2441 and we hope you're all going to party hard! Don't forget that Sector 3 is the only place where illicit products are available and tolerated. If you witness any drug or alcohol use outside this sector, don't forget to notify your local police station.

- This was a health statement from Evolt Corporation -

Yeah! Don't forget about our friends at Evolt Corp, and remember to wish them a happy new year! Now for the latest news:

We are going to end this dark and dreadful year with good news, for a change!

-Our developer who had a severe accident is getting better every day, and he will be able to run and jump again in a few months. On the good side, the new metal implants in his body are making him even more eligible for a Doll-City citizenship.

-Next year, we will start a small dev blog with at least one weekly post to keep you informed about the latest Doll City: Prologue updates and progress. Sector 3 is coming to your VR headset, and it's gonna be huge!
But above all, don't forget:

-All the InfiniVerse team wishes you a wonderful new year. And, yes, we are watching you.

https://youtu.be/ZaMBmMSdxs4

notes.title: HTC Vive roomscale mode & controllers are now supported!
notes.content:
The long wait is finally over! Doll City: Prologue now has a full HTC Vive support, taking advantage of roomscale and motion controllers, bringing drastic changes in gameplay and aesthetics.

 Some general improvements have also been made.

What's new:

  - 5 levels now have roomscale support. We will add more roomscale levels with every new update until the final version.
  
  - New tutorial levels for seated and roomscale modes.

  - The hub level has been remade.

  - Various bugs have been fixed, and we made some improvements on several aspects of the game.


We heard your comments, and we are working very hard on making Doll City a unique game and a mind blowing VR experience.

notes.title: First update! Teleport mode & 4 bonus levels.
notes.content:
Hello and thanks again for supporting our project. We are a small team of 4 VR adventurers doing our best to bring you a beautiful and immersive VR experience.

First of all, we want to reassure you again: the game will support Vive controllers and roomscale, we will start bringing these features on the next update, due for release next weekend if everything goes as planned!
Anyway, we heard all your requests and feedback, and here is the first update:

  - A new teleportation system for seated mode (RB to teleport and LB to orient teleportation).

  - Added a room between levels 0 and 1 as a narrative arc (includes a video).

  - Some texts in levels 0 and 1 heve been fixed and now display properly.

  - Added 4 new rooms in the bonus part (including some rooms from the demo)

  - Fixed some bugs and rewrote some instructions.
Notes: 
  
- Teleportation is active for most levels but not for the platformer ones, as it would make them lose all interest. 

  - Roomscale version of these levels will have a teleportation system that doesn't break the platforming aspect.
Thanks again, and see you in the streets of Doll City!

Team : InfiniVerse
